COMMERCIAL FLEET PROTECTION

Comprehensive Coverage for Every Commercial Vehicle

Shielding company drivers, transport cargo, and commercial utility fleets against road liabilities.

Commercial Auto Liability (BI & PD)

High-limit bodily injury and property damage coverage protecting your business against catastrophic legal and medical expenses if a company driver causes an accident.

→

Collision & Comprehensive Shield

Covers physical damage to company trucks, vans, and utility vehicles from highway collisions, rollovers, theft, vandalism, falling objects, and extreme weather events.

→

Hired & Non-Owned Auto (HNOA)

Essential liability protection when employees use personal vehicles for business errands or your company leases, hires, or rents commercial vehicles temporarily.

→

Motor Truck Cargo & Equipment

Safeguards customer goods, raw materials, inventory, and specialized tools while in transit against theft, transit damage, spoilage, or highway overturn.

→

Uninsured / Underinsured Motorist

Shields your company drivers and vehicles if struck by an at-fault driver who lacks insurance, has insufficient limits, or leaves the scene.

→

GOT QUESTIONS?

Commercial Auto FAQ

Clear answers about commercial liability, fleet telematics, HNOA, and cargo protection.

Any vehicle titled to a business or used primarily for commercial purposes—such as transporting equipment, delivering goods, driving clients, hauling cargo, or displaying commercial branding—must be covered under a commercial auto policy. Personal auto policies almost always exclude business use.
HNOA covers your business against liability if an employee causes an accident while driving their own personal vehicle for company business (like delivering orders, picking up supplies, or driving to job sites) or if your company rents a vehicle for work. It is essential for protecting your business against vicarious liability.
Premiums depend on vehicle types and weights, annual mileage, operational radius, cargo hauled, driver motor vehicle records (MVRs), fleet safety telematics, and chosen policy limits and deductibles. Surebound helps you qualify for discounts up to 35% based on driver safety programs.
Yes. Our digital policyholder portal allows fleet managers and business owners to submit vehicle additions, swaps, and new driver authorizations 24/7 with instant endorsement processing and immediate digital proof of insurance certificates.
Commercial auto comprehensive and collision covers damage to the vehicle itself. To protect tools, machinery, and cargo carried inside the vehicle, you can add an Inland Marine or Motor Truck Cargo rider to your Surebound policy for complete protection.
